summary: Frontend E2E testing of individual (negotiated) price feature for logged-in client user@demo.com on product 8cd5b1c5-7980-4765-9db9-8e309614f8c5 (article E82KPD36, regular price 1600 ₽, individual price 777 ₽). PRODUCT PAGE works correctly. CATALOG CARD has a critical bug: main agent updated /app/frontend/src/components/ProductCard.js, but CatalogPage.js uses its OWN inline ProductCard component (declared locally at line 41) that was NOT updated to include the required data-testids or the 'Ваша цена по договорённости' badge.

test_results.1_catalog_card_individual_price_logged_i: FAIL — Visually the catalog card DOES render strikethrough 1 600 ₽ and 777 ₽ in emerald (because CatalogPage.js inline PriceDisplay handles individualPrice), BUT: (a) data-testid='old-price-<id>' MISSING, (b) data-testid='individual-price-<id>' MISSING, (c) data-testid='individual-badge-<id>' MISSING, (d) The text badge 'Ваша цена по договорённости' is NOT rendered in the catalog card at all.
test_results.2_product_page_individual_price_logged_i: PASS — /product/8cd5b1c5... shows strikethrough 1 600 ₽ and 'product-price' = '777 ₽' in emerald, and 'individual-price-badge' = 'Ваша цена по договорённости'.
test_results.3_guest_product_page: PASS — Guest sees regular price 1 600 ₽; individual-price-badge is NOT present.
test_results.4_guest_catalog: PASS — Guest catalog card for the same product shows regular price '1 600 ₽' without strikethrough; individual-price-<id> and individual-badge-<id> are absent.
test_results.5_other_products_no_individual_price: PASS — No spurious individual badges/prices were observed on other products for the logged-in user.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing data-testid attributes (old-price-<id>, individual-price-<id>, individual-badge-<id>) required by acceptance criteria.
Catalog card does not render the badge text 'Ваша цена по договорённости' for products with individual price. Only the strikethrough+emerald price is shown.

action_items: Main agent must update CatalogPage.js — NOT /app/frontend/src/components/ProductCard.js. The shared ProductCard.js is currently DEAD CODE (not imported anywhere; grep proven).

In CatalogPage.js inline ProductCard (lines ~208-212 in the row-layout and the equivalent block used by grid layout) add data-testid='old-price-<product.id>' on the strikethrough span, data-testid='individual-price-<product.id>' on the emerald price span, and add a new element with data-testid='individual-badge-<product.id>' containing the text 'Ваша цена по договорённости' (e.g. an inline-flex pill like the one used on ProductPage.js line 357).

Optionally also wire CatalogPage's existing individualPrices map to read from the new IndividualPriceContext (useIndividualPrice) instead of calling /individual-prices/my locally, so the new GET /products/my-individual-prices endpoint is actually exercised from the catalog. Currently CatalogPage still calls the OLD /individual-prices/my endpoint at line 506, completely bypassing the new IndividualPriceProvider added in App.js.
critical_code_review_comments: Dead code: /app/frontend/src/components/ProductCard.js is exported but never imported anywhere in the codebase (verified via grep). All product card rendering happens inside CatalogPage.js's inline component. The main agent's edits to components/ProductCard.js had zero runtime effect on the catalog flow.
Duplication: PriceDisplay/ProductCard logic duplicated between CatalogPage.js (inline) and components/ProductCard.js (orphan). Consolidate into one shared component to prevent this bug class.

IndividualPriceContext added in App.js but CatalogPage.js still uses its own axios.get('/individual-prices/my') (line 503-509). Two parallel client-side caches for the same data — risk of inconsistency.
CatalogPage.js is 1300 lines — should be split into smaller modules (PriceDisplay, ProductCard row/grid, filters, modal).

success_rate.frontend: 60% (3/5 scenarios — product page + guest flows + other-products pass; catalog card with individual price fails acceptance criteria)

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent edits CatalogPage.js inline ProductCard, re-run scenario 1 only — verify the three data-testids and the 'Ваша цена по договорённости' badge appear on /catalog?search=E82KPD36 for user@demo.com on product 8cd5b1c5-7980-4765-9db9-8e309614f8c5. Allow ~3s after navigation for axios.get('/individual-prices/my') to populate the individualPrices state. Other scenarios (product page, guest, other-products) already pass.
rca_of_the_issue: The main agent assumed the catalog uses the shared /app/frontend/src/components/ProductCard.js component. In fact, /app/frontend/src/pages/CatalogPage.js declares its OWN inline `const ProductCard = (...)` at line 41 and uses that exclusively (line 1211 and 1244). The shared file is orphaned. As a result, all the individual-price markup the main agent added (old-price-<id>, individual-price-<id>, individual-badge-<id>, 'Ваша цена по договорённости' label, Handshake icon) never reaches the user. Fix: replicate the markup inside CatalogPage.js inline component (lines 208-212), or — preferable — import and reuse the shared ProductCard.
